programme.title: Wonderblocks
programme.desc: Giant Beanstalk. Again wants to pick apples from the top of a tree, but how can he reach them? With a giant beanstalk, of course!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red Meets Blue. Red discovers that she's not the only colour in the world when she meets Blue. Learn which objects can be red and which can be blue, and how some can be both red and blue.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Listening Badge. The Squirrels hear a strange sound that they've not heard before, so they ask Duggee to help identify it.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Code Crackers. Sonny finds an old musical safe, which only opens with the right musical code. With Yukee's help, Sonny tries every tune he can think of, but none opens the box.

programme.title: Something Special: We're All Friends
programme.desc: Stories. Justin and his friends are on a pirate adventure - searching for buried treasure! Meanwhile, Mr Tumble is struggling to decide which story to read to Tumble Ted.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Yellow. Preschool series. It's a special day for yellow Laa-Laa. Big yellow flowers grow in Teletubbyland and a yellow balloon leads Laa-Laa to Tiddlytubby Umby Pumby.

programme.title: Andy's Safari Adventures
programme.desc: Andy and the Komodo Dragon. Andy heads to Indonesia in search of the world's largest lizard, the Komodo dragon.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle the Grand-Dog. Gram and Grand visit. Waffle loves Gram; he'll only leave his new dog doormat for her.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Mrs Juniper's Choir. Preschool drama series. When the kids accidentally unwind Mrs Juniper's cassette tape, Molly forms a choir to sing for Mrs Juniper while Bob fixes things.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Crocky's Wobbly Tooth. Stop-frame animation featuring Raa Raa, who lives in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Crocky really wants his wobbly tooth to fall out.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: Thanks Trunky! Long-tailed aliens on a lush, green planet teach the Game Catchers to play jump and spin.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Octonauts and the Hidden Lake. Animated deep sea adventure series. In Antarctica, Shellington discovers strange microscopic creatures living under the ice.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: The Tale of the Terrible Trap. Animated series. Tired of being constantly humiliated, the predators devise a plan that will get rid of that pesky Peter Rabbit once and for all!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Harvest Badge. Animated preschool series. The birds are tweeting and all the crops are looking ripe and ready to pick. Duggee is getting ready to harvest them.

programme.title: New: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Baby Mouse's First Step. Sunny is nervous that Baby Mouse will get hurt when she starts to take her first steps.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Cheese Moon. It's a space race as Supertato helps Carrot fly her baguette rocket to become the first Veggie on the cheese moon, but halfway there Evil Pea makes them crash land.

programme.title: New: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Mission Birthday. It's Weasy's birthday! He is keen to find out if the Ducklings got him his dream present, but he keeps ruining their party preparations.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Dino Dig. Mojo's got the perfect top for digging up the bones of a Swoppitus Rex. But could an actual dinosaur still be alive under Jackson's field, or is it a case of mistaken identity?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Cubby. Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy, Kimjim.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Seesaw. Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Mysterious Monster. The shadow of a spiky monster causes panic for the Piris, but is all exactly as it seems?

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Mission: Party Time. Disability dog Tinks is determined to help Charli feel confident enough to go to a party.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle's School Walkies. Waffle walks Evie to school on her first day and gets into trouble with the headteacher.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Rise and Shine. Isabelle is staying with Oona for the night, and Oona wants to impress. They take a midnight journey to see the most amazing sight - plankton lighting up the sea.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: It's Time to Look for Night-time Animals. JoJo learns all about the different animals you can only spot at night.

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Where Are the Friends? Everybody is very surprised to discover the Roundabout has been left in the sitting room.

programme.desc: Brand new series: Beatle-maniac Zach hosts a music-inspired night. But when a guest launches a fork at the table, can Zach compose himself and serve up a musical masterpiece? (Ep4/5)

programme.title: America's Next Top Model
programme.desc: Margherita Missoni: The remaining contestants jet off to Venice for a shoot on the famous Grand Canal in period couture, but extreme heat and driving rain make things difficult.

programme.title: New: Married at First Sight UK
programme.desc: Reunion: Brand new series - It's the reunion dinner party and in true MAFS style, across-the-table action is served as two brides clash. And one groom faces a reckoning!

programme.title: New: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Brand new series: Melvin Odoom takes the mic in Mel Giedroyc's adult book club. In a saucy fanfic performed by puppets, Melvin pines after Ed Sheeran. Will they make sweet music? (Ep5/6)

programme.title: European Qualifier
programme.desc: England v Serbia (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the FIFA World Cup Group K qualifier at Wembley Stadium. England produced an excellent display in September's reverse fixture to win 5-0 in Belgrade, with five different players finding the net, and they followed that up with a victory by the same scoreline in Latvia that secured their place at next year's World Cup. It remains to be seen whether Thomas Tuchel will look to experiment with his side or continue building momentum with the strongest team he has available to him, but Serbia are in need of a result as they are battling it out with Albania for second place in the group and a spot in the play-offs. With analysis from Ian Wright and Roy Keane, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon

programme.desc: England v Serbia (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the FIFA World Cup Group K qualifier at Wembley Stadium. England produced an excellent display in September's reverse fixture to win 5-0 in Belgrade, with five different players finding the net, and they followed that up with a victory by the same scoreline in Latvia that secured their place at next year's World Cup.
